items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Well anyway, so that office hired me to make a hit with Chick.

ctx.x: Well anyway, so that office hired me to make a hit with Chick. And Chick, who’d had a wonderful band all those years, and with like Cootie and Johnny, lived in an apartment with Chick, they were all hungry. And they’d had offers but they wouldn’t leave Chick. Johnny was supposed to be Chick’s cousin which he wasn’t. But they were very close. And Chick had this wonderful background, and it never happened. And you see he had TB. He had TB. People didn’t know, but they knew he wasn’t well. And he was the bravest…

wondered why, because you couldn’t see who was in the middle. It was Chick. And he’d get people by their lapel and tell them things. Everybody loved him. And Stanley and I had a very marvelous experience because when Stanley came over we went up you know, and he called me “Oakley,” Chick. He’d say, “Oakley, this kid” — Stanley blamed me for this story — but he told me, “Oakley, this kid’s in love wich you.” Wich you. And of course naturally Stanley didn’t expect to be taken seriously, and he wasn’t. But anyway we…
